{{Quote|You saved the Emperor from Zaarin's treacherous hands. The Empire is safe for the moment. However, Imperial Intelligence has reviewed the action from the previous mission. It appears the gunboats that attacked the Emperor's ship were part of the Emperor's own special reserve guard.|[[Priest (Secret Order of the Emperor)|Lesser Prophet]]|<ref name="Star Wars: TIE Fighter">[[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']]</ref>}}
The '''Emperor's special reserve guard''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] that served as a reserve guard for [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].

Two of the members of traitorous [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin]]'s [[Zaarin's fleet|fleet]], pilots of [[Mu Squadron]] ([[Z-Mu Squadron]]), that attacked Palpatine's [[C-3 passenger liner]] ''[[Excalibur]]'' were also members of the Emperor's special reserve guard, which was discovered by [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] shortly after the attack was quelled by [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]]. This discovery led to the realization that there were spies of Zaarin that had penetrated even the very inner workings of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] hierarchy.
